exposure: adherence to Italian national guidelines on PPH management
outcome: adherence to national clinical and organisational key recommendations on PPH management
cohort: The study enrolled 1100 women who experienced postpartum haemorrhage of 1000 mL or more.
finding: The study found an improved adherence to 16/17 key recommendations of the Italian PPH guidelines and overall appropriate PPH management, though some procedures highlighted a gap between recommended practices and daily care.
cross-section timing: At the time of postpartum haemorrhage event (>= 1000 mL)
